chapter_title: Concerning the Five Storehouses that have poured forth from the Land of Darkness since the [Beginning]; the Five Rulers, the Five Spirits, the Five Bodies, the Five Tastes.
chapter_note: Core material dominates: a highly schematic pentadic cosmology of the Land of Darkness (storehouses → elements → trees → genera; and five worlds with kings/spirits/bodies/tastes), plus a detailed physiognomy and faculties of the King of Darkness. A strong editorial/application drift appears in the second half: several paragraphs keep the old correspondential mapping (face/metal/taste) but pivot to identifying the ‘spirit’ in contemporary institutions (principalities, leaders, temples, sects, soothsayers) and to direct exhortation.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic dialogue-frame attribution (‘Once again… speaks to his disciples’) is hagiographic container language added by the compilers.

paragraphs.core_text: Five storehouses have arisen since the beginning in the land of darkness! The five elements poured out of them. Also, from the five elements were fashioned the five trees! Again, from the five trees were fashioned the five genera of creatures in each world, male and female. And the five worlds themselves have five kings therein, and five spirits, five bodies, five tastes; in each world, they not resembling one another!
paragraphs.temporal_note: Impersonal, schematic pentadic cosmogony (storehouses→elements→trees→genera; five-fold rulers/spirits/bodies/tastes) with cosmos→cosmos mappings and no audience address/citation.

paragraphs.core_text: The King of the world of Smoke [ ... ] who came up from the depth of darkness; this is he who is the head of all wickedness, and all malignity. The beginning of the spread of the war occured through him; all the battles, fights, quarrelling, dangers, destructions, fights, wrestling-contests! That is the one who first made arise danger and war, with his worlds and his powers. Afterwards, also, he waged war with the light. He pitched a battle with the exalted kingdom.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Mythic-cosmological narration inside the system (world of Smoke; war with Light/kingdom), without contemporary institutional pointing.

paragraphs.core_text:
⟨p.31⟩
Now, regarding the King of Darkness, there are five shapes on him! His head is lion-faced; his hands and feet are demon- and devil-faced; his shoulders are eagle-faced; while his belly is dragon-faced; his tail is fish-faced. These five shapes, the marks of his five worlds, exist on the King of the realms of Darkness!
paragraphs.temporal_note: Classic substrate physiognomic correspondences (five worlds marked on the King’s body) remain entirely within cosmic description.

paragraphs.core_text: Now, there are five other properties in him. The first is his darkness. The second is his putridity. The third is his ugliness. The fourth is his bitterness, his own soul. The fifth is his burning, which burns like an iron () as if poured out from fire.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Numbered five-fold property list; impersonal descriptive voice; no exhortation or institutional targets.

paragraphs.core_text: [There are] also three others in him! The first, that his body is hard and very tough, even as she has formed him [ ... ] cruel-hearted; namely Matter, who is the thought of death, [the o]ne who sculpted him from the nature of the land of darkness. This is the manner of the body of the ruler of Smoke. He is harder than every iron, copper and steel and lead; as there is no cleaver at all, nor any iron implement, can [ ... ] him and cut him. For Matter, his fashioner, has formed him [ ... ] strong and hard.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Degree/faculty enumeration continues (‘three others’); cosmic artisan ‘Matter’ and metal-comparison remain cosmological (cosmos→cosmos), despite possible redactional tension noted in scholarship.

paragraphs.core_text: The second, that he wounds and kills by the word of his magic arts. His recitation and hearing, all his foolish instruction, make magic and invocations for him. When it pleases him, he can make an invocation over himself, and by his magic arts be hidden from his companions. Again, when it pleases him, he can be manifested over his powers and appear to them;
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the pivot from cosmic faculty-description to present-world application and exhortation: ‘so that these enchantments nowadays, which people utilise (?) [ ... ] this world… Concerning this, I command you… Keep away…’ plus the eschatological/legal warning that follows. This material points to contemporary practice (‘nowadays’, ‘people utilise’) and addresses the audience directly (imperatives), marking a later application layer.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Opens as substrate: enumerated ‘second’ property describing the King’s operative faculty within the dark cosmos. Mid-paragraph it turns to ‘nowadays… in this world’ and direct commands—editorial application voice.

paragraphs.core_text:
⟨p.32⟩
The third, that the King of the realms of Darkness knows the converse and language of his five worlds. He understands every thing he hears from their mouths, as they address one another; each one of them in his language. [Every] design they will consider against him, every snare they debate with one another to bring upon him, he knows them! He can also understand the gesturing they signal between one another. Yet, his powers and his rulers, who are subject to him, can not understand his wordy converse. While all these things are unveiled to him; still, their heart is not manifested to him. He knows not their mind nor their thought; he can not ponder their beginning and their end. Rather, he only knows and apprehends what is before his eyes.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third faculty continues in impersonal system-description (knowledge/limits of perception) entirely inside dark-world hierarchy.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, another different thing is found in the King of the realms of Darkness! For when it pleases him to move, he spreads all his limbs out and walks. When it comes to mind, he with[d]raws his limbs and takes them in, and is rolled (?) to his companions; and he falls to the ground like a grape and a great iron ball! He terrifies by his cry, he is frightful. He frightens his powers with his sound; because when he speaks, being like thunder in the clouds, he resembles the [ ... ] of the rocks [ ... ] When he cries out and [ ... ] and calls [ ... ] over his powers, they shall tremble and to[tter a]nd fall under foot; even as some birds would be [ ... ] the bird [ ... / ... ] and they fall down to the earth. Still, this thing only: he knows not what is far from him, he sees not who is at a distance, nor does he hear him. Rather, whoever is before his face he sees, hearing him and knowing him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Physiology/sensation mechanics (limb-spreading, rolling, thunder-voice, perceptual limits) remain descriptive and cosmological, not hortatory.

paragraphs.core_text: These signs and these evil marks are found in the chief of the demons and fiends, the King of all the mountains of Darkness [ ... the one] to [whom] the land of darkness has given birth, begotten in its cruelty, in its wickedness and its wrath [ ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Summary/identification within the mythic system (‘King… mountains of Darkness’; born from land of darkness). No institutional pointing.

paragraphs.core_text:
⟨p.33⟩
... more than all his fellow rulers, who are in all his worlds.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fragmentary continuation of the preceding cosmic comparison (‘fellow rulers… worlds’); still within the descriptive layer.

paragraphs.core_text: Gold is the body of the King of the realms of Darkness. The body of all the powers who belong to the world of Smoke is gold. And also, the taste of its fruits is salty.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the application-identified ‘spirit’ clause: ‘The spirit of the King… is this one who reigns today in the principalities and authorities of the earth… humiliating mankind…’ This crosses from cosmos→cosmos mapping (metal/taste) into cosmos→contemporary power structures (‘today’, ‘principalities and authorities’).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Starts with classic correspondential register (king/powers ↔ metal; fruits ↔ taste). Then pivots to present-world identification (‘reigns today’), signaling later editorial application.

paragraphs.core_text: In contrast, the King of the worlds of Fire is lion-faced, the foremost of all the beasts. Copper is his body. Again, the body of all the rulers who belong to Fire is copper. Their taste is the sour taste that is in every form.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the institutional/polemical identification of ‘spirit’: ‘Also, the spirit of the King… reigns in the greater ones and the leaders…’ and ‘found in these sects that worship fire…’ This is cosmos→contemporary hierarchy/sectors, not substrate mapping.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Old pentadic mapping persists (face/metal/taste). The appended ‘spirit… leaders… sects’ is an editorial application using the mapping to point outward.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, the King of the worlds of Wind is eagle-face. His body is iron. Also, the body of all they who belong to the Wind is iron. Their taste is the sharp taste that is in every form.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the outward-pointing identification: ‘His spirit is the one of idolatry… in every temple… sites of idols… statue- and image-worship…’ This explicitly targets contemporary cult-sites, a late application layer.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Clean substrate mapping (realm/king ↔ face; body ↔ iron; taste ↔ sharp). The ‘temple/idols’ clause breaks the cosmos-contained correspondences.

paragraphs.core_text: For his part, the King of the world of Water is fish-face. His body is silver. All the other rulers who belong to Water, silver is their body. Also, the taste of their fruit is the sweetness of water, the sweet taste that is in every (form).
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the present-anchored polemical application: ‘Again, the spirit… reigns today in the sects of error; these that dip the baptism of the waters…’ This targets contemporary sectarian practice (‘today’, ‘baptism’) rather than remaining in cosmic registers.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Substrate correspondences (fish-face/silver/sweetness) followed by an application clause aimed at contemporary ‘sects’ and ‘baptism’; no NT citation formula, so this is application/pastoral rather than NT overlay.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, [the Kin]g of the world of Darkness is a dragon. His [body is lead] and tin. All the other rulers [who belong to the world of] Darkness, their body is lead and tin. And also, the taste of their fruits is bitterness.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the outward identification of the reigning spirit: ‘Again, the spirit who reigns in them is the spirit who speaks till today in the soothsayers… givers of portents… possessed…’ This points to contemporary diviners/possession phenomena (‘till today’), an application layer.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Begins as a pure correspondential description (dragon/lead-tin/bitter taste). The ‘till today… soothsayers’ pivot marks later editorial application to recognizable social roles.
Direct address to ‘my brethren… the holy elect’ with imperatives (‘Hold… stay away… Put behind…’) is institutional/pastoral exhortation, not substrate exposition.
